From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Emma Patel <emma@pivotalhealth.com>, Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@pivotalhealth.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, Jan 4, 2026 at 3:03 PM PST
Subject: Quick recap + 30-min preview — 2-3 bracket options

Thanks again for taking time today — great conversation and helpful context on your search for a predictable inference platform. Quick recap and suggested next step: a 30-minute product preview that covers the routes to integrate Redwood with your pipeline (hosted vs dedicated), expected latency for your typical prompts, and security controls for PHI/tokenization.

TL;DR next steps
- Action: book a 30-min product preview (demo + Q&A) with engineering and security stakeholders.
- Inputs we need: who from your team should join (SRE, product, security), and whether you prefer East / West coast times.

I pulled 3 bracket options next week (all ET):
1) Tue Jan 12 — 10:00–10:30 ET
2) Wed Jan 13 — 15:00–15:30 ET
3) Thu Jan 14 — 09:00–09:30 ET

Proposed agenda (attach):
- 5m intro / goals
- 15m product preview focused on integration & perf profile
- 8m security/compliance overview + where to find artifacts
- 2m next steps / mutual action plan

Attachments: 30m-preview-agenda-v1.pdf (PDF)

Markus — I'll have Irene (solutions engineer) join and bring the performance/quant notes. Priyom, flag if you want to include the dedicated-capacity pricing sketch.

Emma/Liam — which bracket works for you and who else should be on the invite?

Best,
Markus Klein
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
markus_klein@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0187

Markus — thanks for the recap. Wed Jan 13 at 15:00 ET works best for our group. I'll bring Liam (Product) and also want to invite our Security lead, Nora Chen (nora.chen@pivotalhealth.com). Would that be OK?

Couple of quick asks so we can prep the right folks:
- Can you send a short checklist / doc that outlines what security artifacts you typically provide for an initial review (SOC2, data retention, KMS options)?
- We'll want a 5–10 minute window during the demo to ask about SSO/KMS and any customer-managed key support.

I'll expect an invite for Jan 13 15:00 ET and will add Nora to the thread unless you prefer an internal-only prep first.

Thanks,
Emma Patel
